title: Vertical trace identity: sum_j |p_S e'_j|^2 = |p_S - p_T|^2 / 2 for an n-plane S and T = q(R^n x {0}) (Simon 4.4)
statement: For all n, l in N, every linear isometry equivalence q of R^(n+l) = Amb n l and every linear subspace S of R^(n+l) with finrank S = n: let T := rotatedPlane q = q(R^n x {0}), p := S.starProjection, P := T.starProjection and, for j in Fin l, e'_j := q(graphPoint 0 (EuclideanSpace.single j 1)) (the image under q of the standard basis vector with index n + j). Then sum_{j in Fin l} |p e'_j|^2 = hsNormSq(p - P) / 2, where hsNormSq A = sum_{k in Fin (n+l)} |A eps_k|^2 over the standard basis eps_k of R^(n+l), and graphPoint a b is the point of R^(n+l) whose first n coordinates are those of a in R^n and whose last l coordinates are those of b in R^l.
lean_statement: ∀ (n ℓ : ℕ) (q : Amb n ℓ ≃ₗᵢ[ℝ] Amb n ℓ) (S : Submodule ℝ (Amb n ℓ)), Module.finrank ℝ S = n → ∑ j : Fin ℓ, ‖S.starProjection (q (graphPoint 0 (EuclideanSpace.single j (1 : ℝ))))‖ ^ 2 = hsNormSq (S.starProjection - (rotatedPlane q).starProjection) / 2
